commonMistakes.en: RCM and CST repeated output transformations
commonMistakes.zhHans: RCM 与 CST 重复输出变换

doneCheck.en: Log, RAW and Rec.709 footage are all interpreted correctly.
doneCheck.zhHans: Log、RAW 和 Rec.709 素材均被正确解释。

risk.en: Superposition of RCM and node CST results in repeated transformations.
risk.zhHans: RCM 与节点 CST 叠加会造成重复变换。

steps.en: Determine the input color space for each type of camera
steps.zhHans: 确定每类相机的输入色彩空间

steps.en: Choosing a technology path between RCM and CST
steps.zhHans: 在 RCM 与 CST 之间选择一种技术路径

steps.en: Make sure the output transformation is only executed once
steps.zhHans: 确认输出变换只执行一次

summary.en: Keep input interpretation and output management consistent.
summary.zhHans: 保证输入解释和输出管理一致。

commonMistakes.en: Do not judge by the display alone; use scopes.
commonMistakes.zhHans: 不用示波器只凭显示器判断

doneCheck.en: The subject is clear and the channel has no unexpected clipping.
doneCheck.zhHans: 主体清楚，通道无意外削波。

risk.en: Crushing black levels is not cinematic.
risk.zhHans: 压死黑位不是电影感。

steps.en: Open Waveform, RGB Parade and Vectorscope
steps.zhHans: 打开 Waveform、RGB Parade 和 Vectorscope

steps.en: First use Offset/HDR to establish overall exposure
steps.zhHans: 先用 Offset/HDR 建立整体曝光

steps.en: Then use Lift/Gamma/Gain or curve to refine
steps.zhHans: 再用 Lift/Gamma/Gain 或曲线细修

summary.en: Establish a credible baseline for exposure, white balance, and saturation.
summary.zhHans: 建立可信的曝光、白平衡与饱和度基线。

commonMistakes.en: Match objects that happen to be different in the picture
commonMistakes.zhHans: 匹配画面中恰好不同的物体

commonMistakes.en: Each pursues good looks shot by shot

doneCheck.en: There is no obvious brightness or color shift jump during continuous playback.
doneCheck.zhHans: 连续播放没有明显亮度或色偏跳变。

risk.en: Match common references and lighting intentions rather than different objects in the frame.
risk.zhHans: 匹配共同参照和光线意图，而非画面中不同物体。

steps.en: Select a hero shot and grab a still
steps.zhHans: 选择英雄镜头并抓取静帧

steps.en: Match the exposure level first
steps.zhHans: 先匹配曝光层级

steps.en: Then match the comprehensive color cast and saturation
steps.zhHans: 再匹配综合色偏和饱和度

summary.en: Maintain continuity between shots in the same scene.
summary.zhHans: 维持同场景镜头的连续性。

commonMistakes.en: Treat the skin tone line as an absolute goal
commonMistakes.zhHans: 把肤色线当作绝对目标

commonMistakes.en: Key or window edges are too hard

doneCheck.en: The skin is natural, the selection is stable, and the background is free from contamination.
doneCheck.zhHans: 皮肤自然，选择稳定，背景不受污染。

risk.en: The skin color line is a reference direction and is not the same target for everyone.
risk.zhHans: 肤色线是参考方向，不是所有人的同一目标。

steps.en: After the overall white balance is completed, the skin color is limited
steps.zhHans: 整体白平衡完成后再限定肤色

steps.en: Soften keys and limit areas with windows
steps.zhHans: 柔化键并用窗口限制区域

steps.en: Check edges and motion after tracking
steps.zhHans: 跟踪后检查边缘与运动

summary.en: Correct people without contaminating the background.
summary.zhHans: 修正人物而不污染背景。

commonMistakes.en: Technical corrections are mixed in the same node as Look
commonMistakes.zhHans: 技术校正与 Look 混在同一节点

commonMistakes.en: Project-level output management mixed into Look nodes
commonMistakes.zhHans: 项目级输出管理混入 Look 节点

doneCheck.en: Each layer’s purpose remains clear when it is bypassed.
doneCheck.zhHans: 旁路任一层都能理解其作用。

risk.en: Don't mix project-level output management into Look nodes.
risk.zhHans: 不要把项目级输出管理混入 Look 节点。

steps.en: Put noise reduction at the front when needed
steps.zhHans: 将降噪放在需要时的靠前节点

steps.en: Separate Exposure, Match, Local and Look nodes
steps.zhHans: 分离曝光、匹配、局部与 Look 节点

steps.en: Name nodes and bypass comparison
steps.zhHans: 命名节点并可旁路比较

summary.en: Keep technical adjustments and creative looks independently reviewable.
summary.zhHans: 让技术调整和创意风格可单独审阅。

commonMistakes.en: Overdoing noise reduction creates a waxy look or motion smearing.
commonMistakes.zhHans: 降噪过度造成蜡感或拖影

commonMistakes.en: Color labels not checked in target display environment
commonMistakes.zhHans: 未在目标显示环境检查色彩标签

doneCheck.en: Play and pause are natural, and the output labels are correct.
doneCheck.zhHans: 播放与暂停均自然，输出标签正确。

risk.en: Excessive noise reduction can lose skin texture and slow down rendering.
risk.zhHans: 过度降噪会损失皮肤纹理并拖慢渲染。

steps.en: Mainly toning and then a small amount of sharpening
steps.zhHans: 主要调色后再少量锐化

steps.en: Finally, add film grain to unify the texture.
steps.zhHans: 最后加颗粒统一质感

steps.en: Check color labels, highlights and target display environment
steps.zhHans: 检查色彩标签、高光与目标显示环境

summary.en: Preserve detail and texture, then verify in the real delivery environment.
summary.zhHans: 保持细节与质感，并在真实交付环境复核。

title.zhHans: 锐化、颗粒与输出前检查

cause.en: Drive letter/volume name changes, material movement, proxy path failure or codec unavailability.
cause.zhHans: 盘符/卷名变化、素材移动、代理路径失效或编解码器不可用。

deep.en: Check file extensions, camera raw directories, system decoding support, and path case.
deep.zhHans: 检查文件扩展名、相机原始目录、系统解码支持和路径大小写。

fix.en: Confirm that the material disk is mounted and the volume name has not changed
fix.zhHans: 确认素材盘已挂载且卷名未变

fix.en: Select offline clips in media pool > Relink selected clips
fix.zhHans: 媒体池选中离线素材 > 重新链接所选片段

fix.en: If only the agent is offline, switch back to the original media or relocate the agent
fix.zhHans: 若只代理离线，切回原始媒体或重新定位代理

prevent.en: Move media within the project or use media to manage archives without changing the path in the Finder.
prevent.zhHans: 项目内移动媒体或用媒体管理归档，不在 Finder 中随意改路径。

summary.en: The image displays the red Media Offline warning.
summary.zhHans: 画面红色 Media Offline。

cause.en: High compression, long GOP, special effects, noise reduction, slow cache disk or too high resolution.
cause.zhHans: 高压缩长 GOP、特效、降噪、缓存盘慢或分辨率过高。

deep.en: Distinguish between decoding, GPU, and disk bottlenecks; turn off noise reduction for itemized exclusions.
deep.zhHans: 区分解码、GPU 和磁盘瓶颈；关闭降噪逐项排除。

fix.en: Confirm that it is not background rendering or the disk is full
fix.zhHans: 确认不是后台渲染或磁盘已满

fix.en: Playback > Timeline proxy resolution changed to half/quarter
fix.zhHans: 播放 > 时间线代理分辨率改为一半/四分之一

fix.en: Generate proxy media; complex special effects use render cache
fix.zhHans: 生成代理媒体；复杂特效使用渲染缓存

prevent.en: A proxy is used in the editing stage, and the final output is back to the original film; the cache is used to play the high-speed disk independently.
prevent.zhHans: 剪辑阶段用代理，最终输出回原片；缓存独立放高速盘。

summary.en: The timeline drops frames or audio stutters.
summary.zhHans: 时间线掉帧、声音断续。

cause.en: Recording sample rate, variable frame rate mobile footage, incorrect frame rate explanation or sync point error.
cause.zhHans: 录音采样率、可变帧率手机素材、错误帧率解释或同步点错误。

deep.en: A fixed offset allows for overall movement; continued drift requires resampling or fine-tuning the speed.
deep.zhHans: 固定偏移可整体移动；持续漂移需重采样或微调速度。

fix.en: Confirm timeline frame rate and material interpretation
fix.zhHans: 确认时间线帧率和素材解释

fix.en: Mobile phone VFR material is first converted to constant frame rate intermediate code
fix.zhHans: 手机 VFR 素材先转恒定帧率中间码

fix.en: Use the three points of the head, middle and tail to determine whether there is a fixed offset or continuous drift
fix.zhHans: 用头中尾三个点判断固定偏移还是持续漂移

prevent.en: Shoot and plate with unified timecode/sample rate, and check VFR before mobile phone footage is put into storage.
prevent.zhHans: 拍摄统一时间码/采样率并打板，手机素材入库前检查 VFR。

summary.en: Lip sync drifts gradually even when the start is in sync.
summary.zhHans: 开头同步，后段口型逐渐漂移。

title.zhHans: 音画不同步或越播越偏

cause.en: Color tags, viewer gamma, display color management, or duplicate/missing output transformations.
cause.zhHans: 色彩标签、查看器 Gamma、显示色彩管理或重复/缺失输出变换。

deep.en: First distinguish between file data errors and display differences.
deep.zhHans: 先区分文件数据错误与显示差异。

fix.en: Confirm that the output only undergoes a Rec.709 transformation
fix.zhHans: 确认输出只做一次 Rec.709 变换

fix.en: Check Export Color Space/Gamma Tag
fix.zhHans: 检查导出 Color Space/Gamma Tag

fix.en: Compare with controlled player and oscilloscope
fix.zhHans: 用受控播放器和示波器比较

prevent.en: Establish short test files and target platform test procedures to record project color management.
prevent.zhHans: 建立短测试文件和目标平台测试流程，记录项目色彩管理。

summary.en: The Resolve image looks right but QuickTime or a platform looks brighter or washed out.
summary.zhHans: Resolve 内正常，QuickTime 或平台更亮/更灰。

title.en: Export Looks Washed Out or Bright
title.zhHans: 导出后颜色发灰或变亮

cause.en: Proxy filename/timecode mismatch, wrong path, or output settings force proxy use.
cause.zhHans: 代理文件名/时间码不匹配、路径错或输出设置强制使用代理。

deep.en: Spot-check the first frame, duration, frame rate, audio track and time code of the proxy and original film.
deep.zhHans: 抽查代理与原片首帧、时长、帧率、音轨和时间码。

fix.en: Media pool checks proxy path and metadata
fix.zhHans: 媒体池检查代理路径和元数据

fix.en: Disable proxy media, then relink the correct files.
fix.zhHans: 解除代理后重新链接正确文件

fix.en: Delivery advanced settings confirm not using proxy media
fix.zhHans: 交付高级设置确认不使用代理媒体

prevent.en: Standardize proxy presets and naming; do not use unknown low-bitrate files.
prevent.zhHans: 统一代理预设与命名，不用来源不明的低码文件。

summary.en: Shots are offset, offline, or exports still resemble low-resolution proxies.
summary.zhHans: 镜头错位、离线或导出仍像低清代理。

title.en: Proxy Switch Produces the Wrong Image

cause.en: Cache corruption, insufficient location space, or node cache not invalidated.
cause.zhHans: 缓存损坏、位置空间不足或节点缓存没有失效。

deep.en: Don't delete source material by mistake; just clear the CacheClip or manage it via the Resolve menu.
deep.zhHans: 不要误删源素材；只清理 CacheClip 或通过 Resolve 菜单管理。

fix.en: Confirm that the cache disk is writable and has space
fix.zhHans: 确认缓存盘可写且有空间

fix.en: Play > Delete Render Cache > All or Selected Clips
fix.zhHans: 播放 > 删除渲染缓存 > 所有或所选片段

fix.en: Switch cache mode and regenerate if necessary
fix.zhHans: 必要时切换缓存模式后重新生成

prevent.en: Cache an independent directory and clean it regularly. The cache will not be used as an archive when the project is finished.
prevent.zhHans: 缓存独立目录，定期清理，项目结束不把缓存当归档。

summary.en: You see an old effect or the cache repeatedly rebuilds.
summary.zhHans: 修改后仍看到旧效果，缓存条反复重建。

title.en: Cache Is Wrong or Not Updating
title.zhHans: 缓存异常或画面不更新

cause.en: The subtitle export mode is not selected for burning, the external subtitles are not delivered separately, or the subtitle track is disabled.
cause.zhHans: 字幕导出模式未选烧录、外挂字幕没有单独交付或字幕轨被禁用。

deep.en: Clarify the three delivery methods of burning, embedding, and plug-in.
deep.zhHans: 明确烧录、嵌入、外挂三种交付方式。

fix.en: Delivery page chooses to burn to video or export subtitles file
fix.zhHans: 交付页面选择烧录到视频或导出字幕文件

fix.en: Confirm that the correct subtitle track is enabled
fix.zhHans: 确认正确字幕轨启用

fix.en: Output 20 second test and verify on target player
fix.zhHans: 输出 20 秒测试并在目标播放器验证

prevent.en: The delivery list lists subtitle mode, language and file name separately.
prevent.zhHans: 交付清单单列字幕模式、语言和文件名。

summary.en: Subtitles are visible in the timeline but absent from the output.
summary.zhHans: 时间线有字幕，输出文件没有。

cause.en: Bad frames, plug-in, Fusion, VRAM, disk space or encoder issues.
cause.zhHans: 坏帧、插件、Fusion、显存、磁盘空间或编码器问题。

deep.en: For fixed positions, more consideration should be given to materials or special effects; for position changes, more consideration should be given to resources or hardware.
deep.zhHans: 固定位置多考虑素材或特效；位置变化多考虑资源或硬件。

fix.en: Record the failure timecode and check around that frame
fix.zhHans: 记录失败时间码并检查该帧附近

fix.en: Temporarily bypass complex special effects/noise reduction positioning issues
fix.zhHans: 暂时旁路复杂特效/降噪定位问题

fix.en: First output the ProRes/DNxHR intermediate master, and then convert it to the distribution format
fix.zhHans: 先输出 ProRes/DNxHR 中间母版，再转分发格式

prevent.en: For long films, do short tests first; leave margins on the cache disk and output disk.
prevent.zhHans: 长片先做短测试；缓存盘和输出盘保留余量。

summary.en: A render errors, stops, or hangs at a fixed location.
summary.zhHans: 任务报错、停止或在固定位置不动。

title.en: Render Fails or Stops on a Frame
title.zhHans: 渲染失败或卡在某一帧

cause.en: Bus assignments, tracks muted, output audio unchecked, or channel mapping wrong.
cause.zhHans: 总线分配、轨道静音、输出音频未勾选或声道映射错误。

deep.en: Multi-channel delivery requires bus-by-bus, track format and file channel mapping confirmation.
deep.zhHans: 多声道交付需逐个确认 Bus、轨道格式和文件声道映射。

fix.en: Delivery page confirmation Export Audio
fix.zhHans: 交付页面确认 Export Audio

fix.en: Fairlight checks track to bus routing
fix.zhHans: Fairlight 检查轨道到 Bus 的路由

fix.en: Check bus format and export channel settings
fix.zhHans: 检查总线格式与导出声道设置

prevent.en: Save presets for reliable delivery and check your channels with actual files.
prevent.zhHans: 保存可靠交付预设，并用实际文件检查声道。

summary.en: The timeline plays sound but the export is silent or missing channels.
summary.zhHans: 时间线可听，导出静音或缺声道。

cause.en: A frame gap between clips, insufficient transitions, offline frames, or speed effects boundaries.
cause.zhHans: 片段间一帧空隙、转场不足、离线帧或速度特效边界。

deep.en: If there are no gaps in the timeline, check for source file corruption, optical flow, or Fusion boundaries.
deep.zhHans: 若时间线无空隙，检查源文件损坏、光流或 Fusion 边界。

fix.en: Use the up and down arrow keys to jump to the clip point
fix.zhHans: 用上下方向键跳剪辑点

fix.en: Check frame by frame with left and right arrow keys
fix.zhHans: 左右方向键逐帧检查

fix.en: Zoom into the timeline and remove gaps or adjust transition margins
fix.zhHans: 放大时间线并删除空隙或调整转场余量

prevent.en: Perform clip-by-clip QC and black frame detection before locking the picture.
prevent.zhHans: 锁画前做逐剪辑点 QC 和黑帧检测。

summary.en: A brief black frame appears at an edit.
summary.zhHans: 剪辑点短暂黑一下，正常播放不易发现。

cause.en: Real-time saving/backup is not enabled, or the only timeline is always overwritten.
cause.zhHans: 未开启实时保存/备份，或一直覆盖唯一时间线。

deep.en: Copy the project first after recovery to avoid overwriting versions that are still available.
deep.zhHans: 恢复后先复制项目，避免覆盖仍可用的版本。

fix.en: Right-click the project in the project manager to view the backup
fix.zhHans: 项目管理器右键项目查看备份

fix.en: Restore the latest stable backup and save the new version
fix.zhHans: 恢复最近稳定备份并另存新版本

fix.en: Check timeline backup and auto-save locations
fix.zhHans: 检查时间线备份与自动保存位置

prevent.en: Real-time saving + project backup + key node copy timeline.
prevent.zhHans: 实时保存 + 项目备份 + 关键节点复制时间线。

summary.en: A crash or mistaken change leaves no stable version.
summary.zhHans: 崩溃、误改后无法回到稳定版本。

title.en: Project Closed Unexpectedly or Was Damaged

cause.en: Third-party plug-ins, fonts, LUTs or DCTLs are not archived with the project.
cause.zhHans: 第三方插件、字体、LUT 或 DCTL 未随项目归档。

deep.en: Changes in the plug-in version will also change the results, and you cannot just record the plug-in name.
deep.zhHans: 插件版本变化也会改变结果，不能只记录插件名称。

fix.en: View missing item hints and record names
fix.zhHans: 查看缺失项提示并记录名称

fix.en: Install legal resources of the same version
fix.zhHans: 安装合法的同版本资源

fix.en: Rebuild with master reference and mark differences if recovery is not possible
fix.zhHans: 无法恢复时用母版参考重建并标注差异

prevent.en: Archive font lists, plug-in versions, LUT/DCTL and key effects screenshots.
prevent.zhHans: 归档字体清单、插件版本、LUT/DCTL 与关键效果截图。

summary.en: Titles substitute fonts, effects fail, or the image differs.
summary.zhHans: 标题换字体、特效红框、画面不同。

title.en: Missing Plug-ins or Fonts on Another Computer
title.zhHans: 换电脑后插件或字体缺失

bitrate.en: H.264 ~8–16 Mb/s; do a short video test first
bitrate.zhHans: H.264 约 8–16 Mb/s；先做短片测试

fileChecks.en: Play actual file in full
fileChecks.zhHans: 完整播放实际文件

fileChecks.en: Check file name, version and date
fileChecks.zhHans: 检查文件名、版本与日期

fileChecks.en: Check resolution, frame rate, and AAC sound
fileChecks.zhHans: 核对分辨率、帧率和 AAC 声音

fileChecks.en: Randomly check each of the chat software and file transfer method.
fileChecks.zhHans: 在聊天软件与文件传输方式各抽查一次

risk.en: Chat software can perform secondary compression; important film review also provides file transfer methods.
risk.zhHans: 聊天软件可能二次压缩；重要审片同时提供文件传输方式。

value.en: 1920×1080 or the original frame of the project
About 8–16 Mb/s, do a short test first

subtitles.en: The review version can be burned with temporary subtitles or additional SRT, which must be marked in the review instructions.
subtitles.zhHans: 审片版可烧录临时字幕或另附 SRT，须在审片说明中标明。

summary.en: Send a fast review copy with a sensible size-to-quality balance.
summary.zhHans: 快速发送、兼顾体积与清晰度。

bitrate.en: Set according to target platform recommended range; 4K usually requires higher bitrates
bitrate.zhHans: 按目标平台建议范围设置；4K 通常需要更高码率

fileChecks.en: Play actual file in full
fileChecks.zhHans: 完整播放实际文件

fileChecks.en: Check the resolution and frame rate before uploading to the platform
fileChecks.zhHans: 检查平台上传前的分辨率与帧率

fileChecks.en: Check audio, color labels and subtitle tracks
fileChecks.zhHans: 核对音频、色彩标签和字幕轨

fileChecks.en: Upload short test and check platform transcoding
fileChecks.zhHans: 上传短测并检查平台转码

risk.en: Do not forcefully change the frame rate for the platform; high-quality uploading can reduce secondary compression losses.
risk.zhHans: 不要为了平台强改帧率；高质量上传能减少二次压缩损失。

value.en: Use the recommended range of the platform, and increase the 4K appropriately.
value.zhHans: 使用平台建议范围，4K 适当提高

subtitles.en: Burn, embed or upload subtitle files separately according to platform requirements; confirm language and default track.
subtitles.zhHans: 按平台要求烧录、嵌入或单独上传字幕文件；确认语言与默认轨。

summary.en: Upload for YouTube, Bilibili, and similar services.
summary.zhHans: YouTube、Bilibili 等常规上传。

bitrate.en: H.264 approximately 10–20 Mb/s; subject to short measurement on target platform
bitrate.zhHans: H.264 约 10–20 Mb/s；以目标平台短测为准

fileChecks.en: Play actual file in full
fileChecks.zhHans: 完整播放实际文件

fileChecks.en: Check 9:16 Frame and Safe Area
fileChecks.zhHans: 检查 9:16 画幅与安全区域

fileChecks.en: Check subtitles, audio and reconstructed footage
fileChecks.zhHans: 核对字幕、音频和重构画面

fileChecks.en: Short test on target platform

proSteps.en: Ask first about the final deliverable: landscape or portrait, resolution, frame rate, HDR or SDR.
proSteps.zhHans: 先问清最终交付：横竖版、分辨率、帧率、HDR 或 SDR。

proSteps.en: Set the timeline frame rate in Project Settings > Main Settings; changing it after importing the material may be restricted.
proSteps.zhHans: 项目设置 > 主设置中先定时间线帧率；导入素材后再改可能受限。

proSteps.en: Use DaVinci YRGB Color Managed for small SDR projects; when in doubt start with Rec.709 Gamma 2.4 to deliver the target.
proSteps.zhHans: 小型 SDR 项目可用 DaVinci YRGB Color Managed；不确定时先用 Rec.709 Gamma 2.4 交付目标。

proSteps.en: Set the working folder, cache, proxy and still frame locations to a high-speed disk with sufficient capacity.
proSteps.zhHans: 设置工作文件夹、缓存、代理和静帧位置到容量足够的高速盘。

proSteps.en: Turn on real-time saving and set the interval and retention quantity of project backups.
proSteps.zhHans: 打开实时保存，同时设定项目备份的间隔与保留数量。

proSteps.en: Create media pool folders such as 01_MEDIA, 02_AUDIO, 03_GFX, 04_TIMELINES, 99_EXPORTS, etc.
proSteps.zhHans: 创建 01_MEDIA、02_AUDIO、03_GFX、04_TIMELINES、99_EXPORTS 等媒体池文件夹。

quickSteps.en: Create a new project and name it now
Confirm timeline resolution and frame rate

quickSteps.en: Set up automatic saving and project backup
quickSteps.zhHans: 设置自动保存与项目备份

summary.en: Create a project foundation that will not cause problems later.
summary.zhHans: 建立不会在中途反噬你的项目基础。

doneCheck.en: All media are online, audio and video are synchronized and spot-checked, scenes and shots are searchable, and there are two backups.
doneCheck.zhHans: 全部媒体在线、音画同步抽查通过、场景和镜次可搜索且已有两份备份。

mistake.en: Moving the source file in Finder will cause it to go offline; relink it in Resolve when you need to move it.
mistake.zhHans: Finder 中移动源文件会导致离线；需要移动时在 Resolve 内重链接。

proNotes.en: Proxy, media optimization, and render caching are three different things
proNotes.zhHans: 代理、优化媒体、渲染缓存是三件不同的事

proNotes.en: Synchronization must check the beginning, middle and end
proNotes.zhHans: 同步必须抽查头中尾

proSteps.en: The camera card is copied completely according to the original directory, not only the video files are dragged away; at least two independent copies are kept.
proSteps.zhHans: 相机卡按原目录完整复制，不只拖走视频文件；至少保留两份独立存储。

proSteps.en: Import on the media page and check for offline, damaged, abnormal frame rates and audio channels.
proSteps.zhHans: 在媒体页面导入，检查离线、损坏、异常帧率与声道。

proSteps.en: Create a searchable structure using metadata, color tags, keywords or smart bins.
proSteps.zhHans: 用元数据、颜色标记、关键词或智能媒体夹建立可检索结构。

proSteps.en: Dual-system recording prioritizes synchronization based on time code; when there is no time code, use waveform and spot check the beginning, middle and end.
proSteps.zhHans: 双系统录音优先依据时间码同步；无时间码时用波形并抽查头中尾。

proSteps.en: Proxy media is generated when long GOP or high-resolution footage freezes. The proxy is used for editing and the original film is used for final output.
proSteps.zhHans: 长 GOP 或高分辨率素材卡顿时生成代理媒体，代理用于剪辑、原片用于最终输出。

proSteps.en: Create string, featured, and scrap markers for interviews, feature films, or documentaries, preserving original footage.
proSteps.zhHans: 为采访、剧情或纪录片建立字符串、精选和废片标记，保留原始素材。

quickSteps.en: Copy footage and keep card directory
quickSteps.zhHans: 复制素材并保留卡目录

summary.en: Make every shot findable within ten seconds.
summary.zhHans: 让任何一个镜头都能在 10 秒内被找到。

doneCheck.en: The story is understandable from beginning to end, temporary sounds are audible, and questions are tagged by category.
doneCheck.zhHans: 故事从头到尾可理解，临时声音可听清，问题已按类别标记。

mistake.en: Cutting and toning as you go can mask structural problems and waste time.
mistake.zhHans: 边剪边调色会掩盖结构问题并浪费时间。

proNotes.en: The rough cut standard is understandable even if you watch it for the first time
proNotes.zhHans: 粗剪标准是第一次观看也能理解

proNotes.en: Only record when watching in full without interrupting modifications
proNotes.zhHans: 完整观看时只记录，不中断修改

proSteps.en: Create an independent rough cut timeline and avoid overwriting the unique timeline repeatedly.
proSteps.zhHans: 建立独立粗剪时间线，不在唯一时间线上反复覆盖。

proSteps.en: Choose shots based on scene goals and information advancement, and don’t get obsessed with transitions from the beginning.
proSteps.zhHans: 从场景目标和信息推进出发选镜，不要一开始就沉迷转场。

proSteps.en: Use in-point, out-point and three-point editing to quickly send valid clips to the timeline.
proSteps.zhHans: 使用入点、出点与三点剪辑，把有效片段快速送入时间线。

proSteps.en: The structure, paragraphs and rhythm are dealt with first, and the sound is only temporarily balanced so that it can be heard clearly.
proSteps.zhHans: 先处理结构、段落和节奏，声音只做能听清的临时平衡。

proSteps.en: After each paragraph is completed, read back to the end of the previous paragraph to check whether the emotion can be caught.
proSteps.zhHans: 每完成一段就从前一段尾部连看，检查情绪是否接得住。

proSteps.en: Play it all once without interruption, just mark the problem to record it, and make centralized modifications after the playback is over.
proSteps.zhHans: 完整播放一次不中断，只用标记记录问题，播放结束后再集中修改。

quickSteps.en: Watch in full and record questions

summary.en: Build a complete watchable story quickly.
summary.zhHans: 尽快获得完整可观看的故事版本。

doneCheck.en: The acting and dialogue have a natural rhythm, there are no flickering frames or gaps, and the frame-locked version has been saved.
doneCheck.zhHans: 表演与对白节奏自然、无闪帧或空隙，画面锁定版本已保存。

mistake.en: Improper use of ripple trimming may change the subsequent full-film synchronization, and the total duration of observation after the operation will be changed.
mistake.zhHans: 错误使用波纹修剪可能改变后续全片同步，操作后观察总时长。

proNotes.en: Hold down K and click J/L to slow down playback
proNotes.zhHans: 按住 K 再点 J/L 可慢速播放

proNotes.en: The final round of fine editing should be watched once in blind listening and mute listening.
proNotes.zhHans: 精剪最后一轮应盲听和静音各看一次

proSteps.en: Fine-tune the cut point based on performance and reaction, listen to the sound first, and then decide when to cut the scene.
proSteps.zhHans: 从表演与反应出发微调切点，先听声音，再决定画面何时切。

proSteps.en: Use roll, ripple, slip and slide trimming and understand which side each tool changes.
proSteps.zhHans: 使用滚动、波纹、滑移和滑动修剪，理解每种工具改变的是哪一边。

proSteps.en: Use J Cut to let the sound of the next shot come first, and use L Cut to let the sound of the previous shot continue to reduce the feeling of hard cutting.
proSteps.zhHans: 用 J Cut 让下一镜声音先来，用 L Cut 让上一镜声音延续，减少硬切感。

proSteps.en: Check motion matching, eye direction, axis, scene changes, and screen orientation.
proSteps.zhHans: 检查动作匹配、视线方向、轴线、景别变化和屏幕方向。

proSteps.en: Zoom into the timeline to check for black frames, overlapping frames, broken transitions, and missing audio.
proSteps.zhHans: 放大时间线检查一帧黑、重叠帧、断裂转场和误留音频。

proSteps.en: Make a copy of the version before locking the picture and label it picture lock; subsequent changes must be recorded.
proSteps.zhHans: 锁定画面前复制版本并标注 picture lock；之后的变更要有记录。

quickSteps.en: Clean up gaps and flickering frames

summary.en: Make each edit serve emotion and meet delivery standards.
summary.zhHans: 让剪辑点服务情绪，并在技术上干净可交付。

doneCheck.en: Dialogue is always understandable, there are no pops at edit points, the room noise floor is continuous, and the main output doesn't clip.
doneCheck.zhHans: 对白始终可懂、剪辑点无爆音、房间底噪连续且主输出无削波。

mistake.en: Directly applying strong limiting to the main bus may raise the noise floor as well.
mistake.zhHans: 直接对主总线强限幅，可能把底噪一起抬高。

proNotes.en: Keep original sync track
proNotes.zhHans: 保留原始同步声轨

proNotes.en: Dialogue clarity depends on spectrum and background competition, not just level
proNotes.zhHans: 对白清楚取决于频谱和背景竞争，不只是电平

proSteps.en: Separate tracks according to DX dialogue, AMB environment, SFX sound effects, and MX music and name them uniformly.
proSteps.zhHans: 按 DX 对白、AMB 环境、SFX 音效、MX 音乐分轨并统一命名。

proSteps.en: Use clip gain to balance clips first, then use track faders to do the overall mix; don’t pile on plug-ins at the beginning.
proSteps.zhHans: 先用剪辑增益平衡片段，再用轨道推子做整体混音；不要一开始就堆插件。

proSteps.en: Trim hot spots, saliva and obvious noise, cross-fade clip points and fill in the room noise floor.
proSteps.zhHans: 修剪爆点、口水音和明显噪声，交叉淡化剪辑点并补房间底噪。

proSteps.en: EQ should first reduce the problem band, and then consider increasing it; compression only needs to control the dynamics, not flatten the dialogue.
proSteps.zhHans: EQ 先减问题频段，再考虑增加；压缩只需控制动态，不要把对白压扁。

proSteps.en: Music and sound effects take the initiative to give way when dialogue appears, automating when necessary.
proSteps.zhHans: 音乐和音效在对白出现时主动让位，必要时做自动化。

proSteps.en: Listen to it with headphones and regular speakers, and see if the level clips.
proSteps.zhHans: 用耳机和普通扬声器各听一遍，并观察电平是否削波。

quickSteps.en: Musical sound effects give way to dialogue

summary.en: Keep dialogue effortless to hear and believable in the picture.
summary.zhHans: 让观众无需努力就能听清，并相信声音属于画面。

doneCheck.en: Inputs are interpreted correctly, the scope has no unexpected clipping, shots of the same scene match, and output transformations are performed only once.
doneCheck.zhHans: 输入解释正确、示波器无意外削波、同场景镜头匹配且输出变换只执行一次。

mistake.en: Applying LUT directly without color management makes it easy to cut highlights, color casts or repeat changes.
mistake.zhHans: 没有色彩管理就直接套 LUT，容易剪高光、偏色或重复变换。

proNotes.en: The skin color line is a directional reference rather than an absolute target
proNotes.zhHans: 肤色线是方向参考而非绝对目标

proNotes.en: Node naming and grouping should be understandable to the person taking over
proNotes.zhHans: 节点命名和分组应让接手者能看懂

proSteps.en: Confirm the input color space of each type of camera material to avoid treating Log as Rec.709 or repeated conversion.
proSteps.zhHans: 确认每类相机素材的输入色彩空间，避免把 Log 当 Rec.709 或重复转换。

proSteps.en: First look at the waveform chart, RGB Parade, and vector oscilloscope, and then judge the exposure, color cast, and saturation.
proSteps.zhHans: 先看波形图、RGB Parade、矢量示波器，再判断曝光、色偏和饱和度。

proSteps.en: Establish exposure with Offset or HDR global controls, then refine with Lift/Gamma/Gain or Curves.
proSteps.zhHans: 用 Offset 或 HDR 全局控制建立曝光，再用 Lift/Gamma/Gain 或曲线细修。

proSteps.en: Choose a hero shot as a reference and match other shots according to the scene. Don’t pursue beauty shot by shot.
proSteps.zhHans: 选一个英雄镜头作为参考，按场景匹配其他镜头，不要逐镜头各自追求好看。

proSteps.en: Keep selections soft when using qualifiers and windows, and check for motion tracking slippage.
proSteps.zhHans: 使用限定器和窗口时保持选择柔和，并检查运动跟踪是否滑脱。

proSteps.en: Technical corrections are separated from the style nodes; noise reduction is usually at the front, sharpening and grain at the back.
proSteps.zhHans: 技术校正与风格节点分离；降噪通常靠前，锐化和颗粒通常靠后。

proSteps.en: Check output transforms, color labels, and highlight ranges in a live delivery display environment.
proSteps.zhHans: 在实际交付显示环境检查输出变换、色彩标签和高光范围。

quickSteps.en: Confirm input and output color spaces
quickSteps.zhHans: 确认输入与输出色彩空间

quickSteps.en: Open the oscilloscope and perform first-level calibration
quickSteps.zhHans: 打开示波器做一级校正

summary.en: Establish a consistent, credible image before building a look.
summary.zhHans: 先得到一致、可信的图像，再建立风格。

doneCheck.en: The names and numbers are correct, the sentences are segmented naturally, there is no overlap, and the burning/plugging method is clear.
doneCheck.zhHans: 人名数字正确、断句自然、无重叠且烧录/外挂方式明确。

mistake.en: If you only proofread the text without looking at the time, the subtitles will be rushed or trailing.
mistake.zhHans: 只校对文字不看时间，会出现字幕抢话或拖尾。

proNotes.en: Natural sentence segmentation is more important than even word segmentation
proNotes.zhHans: 自然断句比平均分字更重要

proNotes.en: Platform safety areas should be checked separately for both horizontal and vertical versions.
proNotes.zhHans: 横竖版要分别检查平台安全区域

proSteps.en: First determine the font, font size, line spacing, stroke/baseline, number of words per line, and screen stay rules.
proSteps.zhHans: 先确定字体、字号、行距、描边/底板、每行字数和屏幕停留规则。

proSteps.en: Prioritize placing dialogue subtitles on the subtitle track, do not make each one a Fusion title.
proSteps.zhHans: 对白字幕优先放在字幕轨，不要把每条都做成 Fusion 标题。

proSteps.en: After automatic transcription, names, professional words, numbers and sentence fragments must be proofread sentence by sentence.
proSteps.zhHans: 自动转录后必须逐句校对人名、专业词、数字和断句。

proSteps.en: Check whether the subtitles are pressed against the character name bar, platform UI or key information on the screen.
proSteps.zhHans: 检查字幕是否压到人物姓名条、平台 UI 或画面关键信息。

proSteps.en: Check the safe areas separately in the horizontal and vertical versions, and do not rely on automatic adaptation at the same location.
proSteps.zhHans: 横竖版分别检查安全区域，不要依赖同一个位置自动适配。

proSteps.en: Before exporting, decide whether to burn subtitles, plug-in SRT, or deliver both at the same time.
proSteps.zhHans: 导出前决定烧录字幕、外挂 SRT 或两者同时交付。

quickSteps.en: Check safe box and line breaks

summary.en: Keep information accurate, readable, and suited to the delivery frame.
summary.zhHans: 保证信息准确、易读，并适配交付画幅。

doneCheck.en: There are no offline or flickering frames, the subtitle graphics are correct, and the actual exported file has been fully viewed.
doneCheck.zhHans: 无离线或闪帧，字幕图形正确，实际导出文件已完整观看。

mistake.en: If you pause the modification as soon as a problem is discovered, you will lose the audience experience of complete viewing.
mistake.zhHans: 一发现问题就暂停修改，会失去完整观看的观众感受。

proNotes.en: Create QC lists including timecodes, issues, responsible persons and status
proNotes.zhHans: 建立包含时间码、问题、责任人与状态的 QC 清单

proNotes.en: When a frame flashes to black, suspicious editing points need to be reviewed frame by frame.
proNotes.zhHans: 一帧闪黑需要逐帧复查可疑剪辑点

proSteps.en: Watch it in its entirety the first time as an audience, recording only issues of understanding, rhythm, and emotion.
proSteps.zhHans: 第一遍按观众方式完整观看，只记录理解、节奏和情绪问题。

proSteps.en: A second pass checks for flickering frames, black frames, offline media, screen shake, subtitles, graphics, and copyright marks.
proSteps.zhHans: 第二遍检查闪帧、黑帧、离线媒体、画面抖动、字幕、图形和版权标记。

proSteps.en: The third time I blindly listened to the sound, and then watched the picture with the sound muted, I found audio and visual continuity issues respectively.
proSteps.zhHans: 第三遍盲听声音，再静音看画面，分别发现音频与视觉连续性问题。

proSteps.en: Check first frame, last frame, ending duration, text spelling, date, phone number and brand name.
proSteps.zhHans: 检查首帧、尾帧、片尾时长、文字拼写、日期、电话和品牌名称。

proSteps.en: Check the output test file on at least two players or devices to confirm that gamma and audio and video are in sync.
proSteps.zhHans: 在至少两个播放器或设备检查输出测试文件，确认 Gamma 和音画同步。

proSteps.en: Simply watching the affected passages again after restoration is not enough; the final master must be watched again in its entirety.
proSteps.zhHans: 修复后只复看受影响段落仍不够；最终母版必须重新完整观看。

summary.en: Find mistakes before viewers and clients do.
summary.zhHans: 在观众和客户看到之前发现错误。

doneCheck.en: The output range, path, encoding, audio, and subtitles are correct, and the actual file has passed the recheck.
doneCheck.zhHans: 输出范围、路径、编码、音频、字幕正确，实际文件复检通过。

mistake.en: Forcing the timeline frame rate to the delivery frame rate may produce duplicate frames or cadence changes.
mistake.zhHans: 把时间线帧率强改成交付帧率可能产生重复帧或节奏变化。

proNotes.en: Keep high-quality masters first, then generate distribution versions
proNotes.zhHans: 先保留高质量母版，再生成分发版

proNotes.en: For player differences, first check the color label and viewing environment
proNotes.zhHans: 播放器差异先查色彩标签与查看环境

proSteps.en: Deduces packaging, encoding, resolution, bitrate, audio and color tags from delivery usage.
proSteps.zhHans: 从交付用途反推封装、编码、分辨率、码率、音频和色彩标签。

proSteps.en: Determine whether it is a single clip or individual clips, and whether subtitles, alpha, timecode or stems are required.
proSteps.zhHans: 确认是单片段还是各片段、是否需要字幕、Alpha、时间码或片柄。

proSteps.en: Write the project, version, frame, language and date in the file name to avoid calling it just final.mp4.
proSteps.zhHans: 文件名写入项目、版本、画幅、语言和日期，避免只叫 final.mp4。

proSteps.en: A short test is output first to check player, platform compression and color display before rendering the full file.
proSteps.zhHans: 先输出短测试，检查播放器、平台压缩和色彩显示，再渲染完整文件。

proSteps.en: Check the output path, file name, timeline range and preset again after joining the render queue.
proSteps.zhHans: 加入渲染队列后再次检查输出路径、文件名、时间线范围和预设。

proSteps.en: Check the final file for length, resolution, audio tracks, subtitles, color and complete playback.
proSteps.zhHans: 对最终文件做长度、分辨率、音轨、字幕、颜色和完整播放检查。

summary.en: Deliver a playable, color-correct, traceable master.
summary.zhHans: 交付能播放、颜色正确、文件可追溯的成片。

doneCheck.en: The project can be opened, the necessary media has been collected, the master and subtitles are complete, and the README and recovery testing have been completed.
doneCheck.zhHans: 项目可打开、必要媒体已收集、母版与字幕齐全，README 和恢复测试完成。

mistake.en: Saving only the DRP without saving the source media does not guarantee long-term recovery.
mistake.zhHans: 只保存 DRP 不保存源媒体，无法保证长期恢复。

proNotes.en: Archive goals are understandable, verifiable, and recoverable
proNotes.zhHans: 归档目标是可理解、可验证、可恢复

proNotes.en: At least one archive should be physically separated from the work location
proNotes.zhHans: 至少一份归档应与工作地点物理分离

proSteps.en: Export a project file or project archive and record the Resolve version used.
proSteps.zhHans: 导出项目文件或项目归档，并记录使用的 Resolve 版本。

proSteps.en: When using media management to collect actual materials, keep reasonable clip handles and spot-check re-links.
proSteps.zhHans: 使用媒体管理收集实际使用素材时，保留合理片柄并抽查重链接。

proSteps.en: Save high-quality masters, releases, untitled versions, audio tracks, subtitles and key graphics.
proSteps.zhHans: 保存高质量母版、发布版、无字幕版、音频分轨、字幕和关键图形。

proSteps.en: Save LUTs, font lists, color management instructions, plug-in lists, and delivery parameters.
proSteps.zhHans: 保存 LUT、字体清单、色彩管理说明、插件清单和交付参数。

proSteps.en: Generate README: project content, file structure, final timeline, missing items and recovery steps.
proSteps.zhHans: 生成 README：项目内容、文件结构、最后时间线、缺失项和恢复步骤。

proSteps.en: Prove the archive is recoverable by actually opening the project once from the archive location and checking random shots.
proSteps.zhHans: 从归档位置实际打开一次项目并检查随机镜头，证明归档可恢复。

summary.en: Preserve the project, decisions, master, and recovery path.
summary.zhHans: 完整保留项目、决定、母版和恢复路径。
